_comment: Copy this to hosts.json next to it and edit. hosts.json is gitignored.
address: the Tailscale MagicDNS name, or the 100.x.y.z tailnet address.
Do NOT put a LAN address here. The point of going through Tailscale is
that the same name works from anywhere, and that nothing is exposed
password: leave null and the console asks for it and keeps it in memory
only. Fill it in and it sits in plain text on disk - acceptable only if
the file itself is protected. It is never sent anywhere but the host.
role: 'sender' or 'receiver'. Decides which probe commands run and which
